My Self, Inc: Your Better Life Powered by AI

A 3-hour workshop that teaches you to think like a CEO of your own life — and gives you an AI advisor to help you run it.

The Foundation

Everyone is the CEO of their own life.

For the first time in history, any CEO can hire AI consultants to strengthen their Board of Directors — for free. That means: you are one step away from a better life.

What’s the Mental Model?

You are a company with five elements:

  • You, as consciousness — You are the CEO
  • Your Board of Directors — The voices in your head (values, logic, ambition, fear, past experiences)
  • Your Employees — Your emotions (fear, excitement, self-doubt, motivation)
  • Your Treasury — Your time and energy. Capital allocation.
  • Your Machines — Your body and tangible assets

The core idea: The CEO does not directly manage the employees. The Board of Directors does. Those directors are the voices in your head. Some are strong. Some are weak. Some you listen to. Some you ignore.

A beautiful life is when the voices in your head are active, aligned, and working together — enabling your emotions to move your body toward the life you truly want.

Most professionals are technically skilled but mentally stuck. You wait for instructions, you blame circumstances, and you let your inner critic run the show.

This isn’t laziness. It’s a learned behavior.

  • You're waiting to be told what to improve before you improve
  • You don't see your career as a company you're CEO of. You see it as a job you show up to
  • Your emotions (fear, self-doubt, overwhelm) make decisions instead of you
  • By Friday, you feel like things happened *to* you, not *by* you

In this workshop, you learn to:

  • See yourself as the CEO, not just an employee
  • Align your inner Board of Directors so they stop fighting you
  • Make emotions part of your company, not the boss
  • Build an AI advisor that knows you and gives you honest counsel

FAQ

Is this a motivational speech or actual training?
Actual training. You'll walk out with a mental model and a tool, not just inspired feelings. By hour two, people are sketching systems on paper. By hour three, they're using AI to get real advice on real problems. The inspiration is real because the output is real.
What if I'm already self-aware? Will this be obvious?
Even the most self-aware people surprise themselves. The My Self, Inc framework makes something visible that was invisible before. The AI advisor works differently than anything you've used. Come skeptical — the best feedback comes from people who weren't sold on it beforehand.
Will the AI advisor actually be useful, or is it just a gimmick?
It's useful if you actually use it. The AI is only as good as the context you give it. In the workshop, I'll show you how to write context that makes it your personal Board of Directors. After that, it's on you to care enough to ask it real questions.
What's the difference between this and a 10-week program?
This is the door. You learn the model. You build the tool. You make one commitment. The 10-week program is where you go deeper: personal growth plans, accountability partnerships, monthly 1-on-1s, and actual behavioral change. This workshop is how you earn the right to do the longer program with confidence.
Can this be virtual?
Yes. The workshop works virtually, but in-person is better. You'll be sketching on paper, talking with partners, and the presence matters. If you need virtual, let me know and we'll adjust.
